description: Click an element on the page by CSS selector, accessible label or a11y tree ref. Use this to interact with buttons, links, checkboxes, and other clickable elements. In a supervised session, a click that opens a popup makes the popup the current page.

button.description: Mouse button to click with. Default: "left".

click_count.description: Number of clicks (e.g. 2 for double-click). Default: 1.

frame.description: A CSS selector for an iframe, or a list of them for nested iframes. selector, label and ref then resolve inside it.

label.description: Accessible name or visible text to click by. Alternative to selector.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

ref.description: An element ref from this page's latest get_a11y_tree, such as e5, or f1e3 inside an iframe.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click. Either selector, label or ref is required.

wait_after_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after clicking before returning.

name: click
